verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI does support signing in with a Google account without API keys (gemini-cli-gh-13), but community evidence shows this doesn't cleanly map to existing paid subscriptions: a Gemini Pro subscriber found no CLI benefit and had to get a separate 'Code Assist' plan (gemini-cli-comm-3), Workspace account holders were outright blocked from logging in (gemini-cli-comm-5), and multiple users explicitly wished for a unified subscription like Claude's Max plan instead of the current fragmented system (gemini-cli-comm-2, gemini-cli-comm-19).
